registered: 2026-10-30, before scripts/model/model_ack_behaviour.py was written and before any ACK-behaviour model run
evidence_label: SDK tofino-model functional output; not hardware, not wire timing

rule.obsolete: A pure master ACK is obsolete only if a later forwarded master segment already carries everything it carries: a sequence at or beyond, an acknowledgment at or beyond, the same advertised window, and no newer timestamp or supported option.
rule.suppression: An obsolete ACK may be suppressed, but only with connection and transaction state unchanged.
rule.valid: Any ACK carrying new acknowledgment or window information is valid and must reach the relay.

operational_definitions.segment_fields: Master segments are compared in the master's own coordinates as sent on dev9: SEG.SEQ, SEG.LEN (TCP payload octets), SEG.ACK (wire, before E's mapping), the 16-bit advertised window field, TSval, and the set of TCP option kinds. Sequence, acknowledgment and TSval comparisons use 32-bit serial arithmetic (a at or beyond b iff (a - b) mod 2^32 < 2^31).
operational_definitions.later: S is later than A when the master sent S after A (master send order), whatever order the switch received them in.
operational_definitions.already_forwarded: S was forwarded before A's disposition: S reached dev64 in an earlier observation, or in the same observation S's successful stage-0 claim precedes A's successful stage-0 claim in the model log.
operational_definitions.covers: S covers A iff S is later than A, S was already forwarded, SEG.SEQ(S) is at or beyond SEG.SEQ(A) + SEG.LEN(A), SEG.ACK(S) is at or beyond SEG.ACK(A), WND(S) == WND(A), TSval(S) is at or beyond TSval(A), and every option kind A carries is also carried by S.
operational_definitions.obsolete: A is obsolete iff some already-forwarded master segment covers it.
operational_definitions.new_information: new_ack: SEG.ACK(A) is beyond every SEG.ACK of the master segments forwarded before A's disposition. new_window: WND(A) differs from the window of the most recently forwarded master segment (the relay's current view of the master window). Recorded per probe; a probe with either flag set is valid and must reach the relay.
operational_definitions.forwarded: The probe is forwarded iff a frame with its direction, SEG.SEQ, flags and payload length appears on dev64 during its observation (labelling as model_connection_start.label_frames; the master sequence number is not remapped, the ACK and window are). The dev64 copy's ACK, window and TSval are recorded beside the sent values.
operational_definitions.state: N connection and transaction state = the registers owner, client, server, epoch, application_state and retry_epoch, and the work-cell phase (4 = free). 'Unchanged' = equal immediately before the probe and after the model is quiescent. The work-cell generation and the generation allocator (n_Ingress.counter) are recorded but are not part of the condition: every frame's stage-0 claim consumes one generation whether it is forwarded or suppressed; the control cases (duplicate ACK and response ACK, both forwarded) measure that consumption.
operational_definitions.reading_of_the_rule: The rule permits suppression only of obsolete ACKs. Suppressing an ACK that is not obsolete violates the rule even when it carries no new acknowledgment or window information (a keepalive carries a newer TSval and is covered by no later segment).

classification.meets the rule: the probe was forwarded to the relay
classification.meets the rule by suppressing an obsolet: the probe was not forwarded, it is obsolete, and N state is unchanged
classification.violates the rule: the probe was not forwarded and it is not obsolete, or N state changed

operational_definitions.consequence: Stated only from observed disposition and progress: whether the probe and, where RFC 9293 requires one, the relay's reply reached their endpoints; whether the current transaction's response was then delivered at the class image size; whether the next transaction was admitted once and its response delivered at the class image size; and, with T on, T's outcome counts for each timed response (ACK_COMMIT +1, RESP_RELEASE +1, no fallback). 'Matches no row' is never a consequence.
operational_definitions.relay_reply: The model relay is scripted. After a forwarded probe whose SEG.SEQ is before the relay's RCV.NXT (the client register), the driver sends the relay's RFC 9293 reply to an unacceptable segment, <SEQ=SND.NXT><ACK=RCV.NXT><CTL=ACK>, and records where it goes and T's counts. A forwarded probe at RCV.NXT with no data (a window update or duplicate ACK) gets no reply. A suppressed probe gets no reply.

cases.dimensions: every case for both READ classes (mixed 25 B request, integrity 27 B request) and with T on (enabled=1, model_relay_sbo's timed parameters) and T off (enabled=0), on c72, c74 and c75; one fresh connection per case on the same 4-tuple

late_ack_wire_order.stimulus: the master sends the final handshake ACK then the first READ. The work cell is forced held when the ACK arrives, so the ACK busy-retries; the cell is released after the ACK's first retry and the READ is sent at once, so the fresh READ can claim before the retrying ACK (the hardware route to H2). Whether the READ overtook is read from the log (state_reached).

late_ack_reverse_order.stimulus: the ACK built first, the READ sent first and fully processed (owner 0xe), then the ACK (model_connection_fix H2)

r1_ack_behind_read.stimulus: the master's pure ACK of response 1 (built before READ 2) arrives after READ 2 (model_connection_fix residual_later_read)

r2_offset.stimulus: a pure ACK at the client register minus the other READ length (ISN-1 while a mixed READ is outstanding, ISN+3 while an integrity READ is); not produced by a conforming master; outside the decision gate

window_increase_outstanding.stimulus: after the READ is admitted and before any relay segment: a pure ACK at SND.NXT and the current ACK with the window field 4096 -> 4608

window_increase_idle.stimulus: the same window-only ACK at idle (owner 5), after a complete exchange

zero_window_outstanding.stimulus: after the READ is admitted: a pure ACK with window 0, then the reopening ACK with window 4096, then the relay's ACK and response; the response must reach the master

keepalive_idle.stimulus: at idle after a complete exchange: a keepalive at SND.NXT-1 with 0 octets, then one with 1 octet (the last request octet); the relay's reply when forwarded

keepalive_outstanding.stimulus: after the READ is admitted and the relay's ACK of it has been sent: the same two keepalives at SND.NXT-1; the relay's reply when forwarded; then the response. With T on the relay's ACK is held in T, so the master has not received it and a conforming TCP would retransmit rather than probe; the probe is still sent and labelled.

duplicate_ack_idle.stimulus: two identical pure ACKs (same bytes) at idle

response_ack_control.stimulus: the master's normal ACK of a delivered READ response (mapped complete ACK)

predictions_from_rows.basis: first_event kind-3 rows: owner 4 with differences (0,0) first_ack; owners 5, 8, 9, 0xa, 0xb, 0xc with (0,0) forward_original; no kind-3 row for owner 0xd/0xe on c72 and c75; c74 adds owner 0xd/0xe with client_diff -25/-27 and server_diff 0 (forward_original). A kind-3 miss takes the default NoAction (code 255) and the abort laps. The window, TSval and option fields are not first_event keys. A 1-octet segment has ip.len 53, which the N parser does not dispatch, so no packet kind is predicted for it.

late_ack_wire_order.c72: suppressed (abort); obsolete -> meets by suppressing if N state unchanged
late_ack_wire_order.c74: forwarded (forward_original) -> meets; the relay reply then enters T as a READ ACK (open item H-1)

r2_offset.c72: suppressed; mixed (ISN-1) obsolete -> meets by suppressing; integrity (ISN+3) not covered by the READ (its SEG.SEQ ISN+1 is before ISN+3) -> violates (non-conforming stimulus)

window_increase_outstanding.all: owner 0xe, differences (0,0): no row -> suppressed; carries new window -> violates

zero_window_outstanding.all: both the closing and the reopening ACK suppressed -> violates; the response is still sent by the scripted relay

keepalive_idle.all: 0 octets: owner 5, client_diff -1: no row -> suppressed; not obsolete -> violates. 1 octet: not predicted

keepalive_outstanding.all: 0 octets: owner 0xe, client_diff -1 -> suppressed -> violates. 1 octet: not predicted

response_ack_control.all: forwarded with the ACK mapped to the native end -> meets

falsifiers: A probe predicted suppressed reaches dev64, or one predicted forwarded does not: the reading of the rows is wrong for that path.
A suppressed probe changes owner, client, server, epoch, application_state, retry_epoch or leaves the work cell held: suppression is not state-neutral.
The current or next transaction is not admitted, or its response is not delivered at the class image size, or T's counts differ from (1,1,0,0) with T on: the ACK path has an end-to-end consequence.
The generation consumed by a suppressed probe differs from that of a forwarded control ACK: the generation exclusion in 'state' is unjustified.
decision_gate: If a valid window update or keepalive demonstrably breaks supported communication on c75 (or c72) -- a later transaction not admitted, a response not delivered or delivered at the wrong size, or T failing to release with T on -- stop and report the evidence to the coordinator. Do not build a fix candidate and do not add P4 rows. Otherwise record what remains untested.
interpretation_limits: The model relay is scripted: it does not honour the master's window, run timers or retransmit, so a suppressed window update or keepalive cannot change what it sends. Consequences that need a real TCP (a relay sending into a closed window, a master aborting after unanswered keepalives) are inferred, not observed, and are labelled so.
The model does not measure D; T evidence is its outcome counts and the ACK-then-response order at the master.
Forced-register cases are labelled apart from genuine processing.
